issues.detail: The Hebrew 'פְּדוּיֵי הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה וְהַשִּׁבְעִים וְהַמָּאתָיִם' means 'the redeemed ones of the two hundred and seventy-three' (273), but the Chinese renders it as '那三名贖民，和七百二十名' (the three redeemed ones, and seven hundred and twenty), splitting the number 273 into 3 and 720, which is a factual error in the number.
